Repainting the Underpass Together

by Jo Example | Oct 9, 2026

Neighbours gathered on Saturday morning with rollers, brushes and forty litres of donated paint to cover the graffiti that had built up on the underpass walls over the past three years.

The work took six hours. Volunteers rotated in shifts so that nobody stood in the cold for too long, and a local bakery brought coffee and pastries around midday to keep everyone going.

Organisers say the point was never the paint itself but the habit of looking after shared spaces, which they hope will carry over into a tool library and a weekly repair café.

BODY-CLOSING-PARAGRAPH: the group meets again next month at the bus shelter on Mill Road, and anyone who wants to help is welcome to turn up with old clothes and a free afternoon.
